title: DataAsset
description: This schema defines the DataAsset entity. A DataAsset represents a specific data asset instance with dynamic attributes based on its AssetType.

id.description: Unique identifier of a data asset instance.

fullyQualifiedName.description: Fully qualified name of the data asset.

displayName.description: Display Name that identifies this data asset.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

assetType.description: Reference to the AssetType that defines the attributes for this data asset. This is a required field.

catalog.description: Reference to the AssetCatalog this data asset belongs to. Optional field - if null, the asset is not categorized under any catalog.

attributeValues.description: Dynamic attribute values based on the AssetType's attributes definition. Each value corresponds to an attribute from the AssetType.

name.description: Name of the attribute this value corresponds to.

value.description: The actual value of the attribute. Type depends on the attribute's dataType definition.

filledBy.description: User who filled this attribute value.

filledAt.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was filled.

reviewers.description: User references of the reviewers for this data asset.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Incremental change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.

dataProducts.description: List of data products this entity is part of.

extension.description: Entity extension data with custom attributes added to the entity.
